title: 第1章 重回初中

content_zh:
“我齐子衡的未婚妻，若是连这点儿勇气都没有……呵呵，怎么配得上我？”
“今晚九点，体育器材室，我等你。”
看着手机qq上的消息，云画低低地笑了，笑容里是说不尽的讥讽。
她不可能忘记！那可是一套黑色蕾丝性感内衣！
此刻，讲台上音乐老师坐着玩儿手机，随便放几首流行歌就当是音乐课了。教室里到处都是交头接耳的声音。
初二才刚开学，大家暑假玩浪了的心思都还没收回来。
云画坐在教室最后一排，趴在桌子上，她的手紧紧地攥着抽屉里的袋子，脸上露出了一个嗜血的笑容。
直到这一刻，她才确定，自己竟然真的重生了！
是的，重生！
她回到了13岁，初二。
这个时候，她还没被毁容，她的腿也没断，更没被流浪汉侮辱声名狼藉，她和齐子衡的婚约也还在，更没被送去精神病院承受非人的折磨，死不瞑目！
或许是因为上辈子的她太惨了，就连上天都看不过眼，才会给了她这么一次重生的机会。
云画在心底告诉自己，她绝对不会再像上辈子那样，烂好心！
除了母亲，她再不会相信任何人。
上辈子那些利用了她的善良和信任，却反手将她推入地狱的，她一个都不会放过，她要让他们，血债血偿！
她云画的人生，不该是那样。她要拿回一切属于她的荣誉、快乐、尊严，她要还给自己一个锦绣人生！
至于那些害死她的，以彼之道还施彼身，她会让他们明白，什么是真正的地狱！她要让他们，求生不得、求死不能！
摸着课桌抽屉里的东西，云画勾了勾唇，就从今夜开始吧。
她拿起手机当你的未婚妻！可是体育器材室太远了，去档案室好不好嘛？】
按下发送键，云画的指尖几乎在发抖。

很快，qq那边就有消息回来：【行，我等你，不要让我失望。】
云画关上了手机，她几乎快要控制不住自己心底的怒意了。
发生在她初二刚开学的这件事情，她怎么可能会忘记？
她才刚刚得知，自己暗恋已久的齐子衡学长，因为爷爷的关系，竟然和她有婚约！
那可是齐子衡哎，南溪中学闻名遐迩的校草学长，篮球队长、钢琴王子，才华横溢！
更别说他本人那张帅得让人面红心跳的脸，每天不知道多少女生从他教室门口假装路过，就只为了看他一眼。
不仅如此，齐子衡的家世更让人仰望。
那些电视上的青春偶像算什么，齐子衡才是现实中的王子，真正有颜有料、有才有貌、家世尊贵的王子！
女生们都暗恋齐子衡，这太正常了，不暗恋齐子衡的人，不是感情无能就是眼瞎。
可大家也只是暗恋，是小女生之间的互相打趣，她们这些普通女孩子和齐子衡之间的距离，那就是一个天一个地，压根儿想都不敢想的！
她们只敢在日记里写满少女心思，用带着香味的精美信纸写上自己的心意，偷偷塞到齐子衡的课桌里，总有人幻想能幸运地成为齐子衡的女朋友……
云画和这个学校里百分之八十以上的女生一样，都暗恋齐子衡。甚至，她有比别人更多的理由去暗恋齐子衡，因为在她最难堪最无助的时候，是齐子衡帮了她，拯救了她，他就是她绝望时的那根救命稻草……
然而这一切都不过是幻想，谁都知道不可能的啦。
但就在初二刚开学的时候，一个云画做梦都不敢想的馅饼，竟然从天而降，砸中了她！
她和高不可攀的齐子衡学长，竟然有婚约！

content_en:
"If my fiancée, Qi Ziheng, doesn't even have this courage...hehe, how can she be worthy of me?"
"I'll wait for you in the sports equipment room at nine o'clock tonight."
Looking at the messages on QQ on his mobile phone, Yun Hua smiled lowly, with endless sarcasm in his smile.
There's no way she could forget! That's a set of black lace sexy lingerie!
At this moment, the music teacher was sitting on the podium playing with his mobile phone, randomly playing a few pop songs and treating it as a music class. The classroom was full of whispering voices.
The second grade of junior high school has just started, and everyone has not yet recovered from their summer vacation fun.
Yun Hua was sitting in the last row of the classroom, lying on the table, her hands tightly clenching the bag in the drawer, a bloodthirsty smile on her face.
It wasn't until this moment that she was sure that she was really reborn!
Yes, rebirth!
She was 13 years old again, in the second grade of junior high school.
At this time, she had not been disfigured, her legs had not been broken, and she had not been insulted or disgraced by a homeless man. Her engagement with Qi Ziheng was still there, and she had not been sent to a mental hospital to endure inhuman torture and die in peace!
Perhaps it was because she was so miserable in her previous life that even God couldn't bear to see it, so she was given such a chance to be reborn.
Yun Hua told herself in her heart that she would never be as kind-hearted as she was in her previous life!
She will never trust anyone except her mother.
She will not let go of those who took advantage of her kindness and trust in her previous life but pushed her into hell. She will make them pay with blood!
Her Yun Hua life should not be like that. She wants to take back all her honor, happiness, and dignity, and she wants to give herself a beautiful life!
As for those who killed her, they would retaliate in the same way. She would make them understand what real hell is! She wanted them to be unable to survive or die!
Touching the things in the desk drawer, Yun Hua curled his lips and said, "Let's start from tonight."
She picks up the phone and becomes your fiancée! But the sports equipment room is too far away. How about going to the archives room? 】
Yun Hua's fingertips were almost trembling after pressing the send button.
Soon, a message came back from QQ: [Okay, I'll wait for you, don't let me down. 】
Yun Hua turned off her phone. She could hardly control the anger in her heart.
How could she forget this incident that happened when she was in her second year of junior high school?
She had just learned that senior Qi Ziheng, whom she had a crush on for a long time, was engaged to her because of her grandfather!
That was Qi Ziheng, the famous senior student of Nanxi Middle School, basketball captain, piano prince, and so talented!
Not to mention his handsome face that makes people blush and their hearts beat. Every day, countless girls pretend to pass by his classroom door just to take a look at him.
Not only that, Qi Ziheng's family background is even more impressive.
Those youth idols on TV are nothing, Qi Ziheng is the prince in reality, a truly handsome, talented and handsome prince with a noble family background!
It's normal for girls to all have a crush on Qi Ziheng. Anyone who doesn't have a crush on Qi Ziheng is either emotionally incompetent or blind.
But everyone is just secretly in love, it's just a joke among the little girls. The distance between ordinary girls like them and Qi Ziheng is so wide that they can't even think about it!
They only dare to fill their diaries with girlish thoughts, write their feelings on beautiful scented stationery, and secretly stuff them into Qi Ziheng's desk. There are always some people who dream of being lucky enough to become Qi Ziheng's girlfriend...
Yun Hua, like more than 80% of the girls in this school, has a crush on Qi Ziheng. She even had more reasons than others to have a crush on Qi Ziheng, because when she was most embarrassed and helpless, it was Qi Ziheng who helped her and saved her. He was the life-saving straw when she was desperate...
However, all this is just a fantasy, everyone knows it is impossible.
But just after the second day of junior high school,When she was studying, a pie that Yun Hua never dreamed of fell from the sky and hit her!
She and the unattainable senior Qi Ziheng are actually engaged!
If you like the goddess of academic tyranny, she’s so awesome. Please give her a thumbs up.
